QuestInfo.name: [World Tour] Bull Slayer
QuestInfo.0: The bulls of the Spanish bull run possess immense strength. \r\nYou can get a special title for defeating 50 of them!
QuestInfo.1: The bulls of the Spanish bull run possess immense strength. \r\nYou can get a special title for defeating 50 of them!
QuestInfo.2: You defeated 50 bulls! You're so strong!

0.0: Did you participate in the Spanish bull run? \r\nI'll give you a special title if you hunt those powerful Spanish bulls. How about it?

yes.0: Hunt 50 Spanish bulls of any type. Red, yellow, or black are all fine. The red ones are the weakest, so maybe focus on those?

no.0: Those bulls may be strong, but they shouldn't be too tough if you focus on attacking the red bulls. \r\nWhat do you say?

1.0: What'd you think of the bulls? They tougher than they look?

yes.0: You're incredible! You deserve this Bull Slayer title.

mob.0: The bulls are tougher than they look, huh? Focus on attacking the weaker red bulls!
